name: MarketSentinel
vision: MarketSentinel ingests CMC API data into iExec Nox TEE to confidentially detect market manipulation. Three encrypted sub-scores—wash trading, exchange concentration, pump patterns—produce on-chain TokenClean/TokenManipulated signals for DeFi defense.

name: RWA AI Research Agent
vision: An autonomous MCP research agent powered by CoinMarketCap's RWA endpoints and FastMCP. Standardizes cross-asset liquidity, resolves secondary token wrappers across chains, and delivers real-time market analysis into Claude Desktop.

name: Cap or No Cap
vision: A live higher/lower guessing game on CoinMarketCap data. Two assets, one revealed stat, one hidden. Guess higher, or "no cap" (lower).

name: CMC-Sentinel-MCP
vision: AI agent execution firewall powered by CoinMarketCap Pro API. Integrates live orderbook depth and sentiment via MCP to block catastrophic slippage, honeypot traps, and MEV attacks before on-chain dispatch.

name: Pulse Screener
vision: A fast, transparent CoinMarketCap API-powered market screener that helps users see what is moving, inspect market context, and set safer price alerts.

name: CMC Market Detective
vision: An AI market detective powered by CoinMarketCap: detect unusual moves, investigate the evidence, compare market context, find similar setups, and generate grounded explanations—without inventing catalysts or predictions.

name: PerpsIA
vision: PerpsIA is an AI crypto market intelligence agent combining derivatives, technical analysis, Smart Money Concepts, on-chain data, sentiment, macro context, and research to help traders discover opportunities faster and more safely.

name: Bedrock
vision: Tokenized real-world assets are exploding — ~7,900 tracked by CoinMarketCap — but prices alone don't show if they're trustworthy. Bedrock ranks live wrapper spreads, shows issuers and chains, links SEC filings, and fixes the API's own data gaps.

name: Backstop
vision: 7,811 rows in CoinMarketCap's RWA catalogue; under 800 carry a token, and fifteen issuers hold all the value. Backstop attributes value per token, not per asset, measures how concentrated that is, and publishes every hole in the data beside the figures.

name: Argus
vision: Crypto dashboards tell you what moved, never why. Argus watches the top 200 coins, flags what is unusual for each one, investigates it with live CoinMarketCap data, and shows every API call behind the answer so you can check it.

name: Crypto Screener
vision: One screen that answers what's moving, what you can trade, and whether to trust the move — instead of tabbing between CoinMarketCap, an exchange, and TradingView for the same question.

name: Signal Desk
vision: Signal Desk answers what a price cannot, whether the market is taking risk and how much of it is participating, then says so when sentiment and participation disagree. It also resolves a tokenised stock back to the company that issued the shares.

name: RWA(Real World Assets) Compass
vision: RWA Compass is an AI agent that reads CoinMarketCap's real RWA data to answer what a tokenized asset is, how liquid it really is, and how it compares — citing real numbers, never a vibe-only verdict.

name: Parity
vision: Fair-price and wrapper-spread layer for tokenised stocks

name: CMC Agent Tools
vision: MCP server exposing live CoinMarketCap data as agent tools: price, market, and listings lookups, plus get_liquidation_risk, which computes DeFi health factor and liquidation price from live CMC prices, turning raw data into a real risk decision.

name: KeeperHub Agent Economy
vision: Web3 payments are fragmented — users switch between wallets, exchanges, and DeFi protocols to send money , and MPP routing into a single agent-powered payment layer — enabling natural-language-driven on-chain transactions with instant settlement.

name: Divergence
vision: CoinMarketCap never plots what the market is saying against what it has committed money to. Divergence does: Voice and Money, both 0-100, and the gap between them, recorded every 15 minutes because positioning history cannot be fetched retroactively.

name: Baserate
vision: Crypto screeners show what matches today. BaseRate also shows what happened the last few thousand times — on two years of CoinMarketCap data.

name: MarketMind
vision: MarketMind turns raw cryptocurrency market data into understandable AI-powered market intelligence, helping users understand not just what moved, but what the data may be telling them.

name: Python CLI tool
vision: A Python Script that can be used to send notifications to a specified email address, and can be further modified to monitor market inefficiencies, arbitrage opportunities etc ..

name: Precedent Panel
vision: Precedent Panel turns every DeFi price lookup into a risk snapshot: governance flags, treasury concentration, hack alerts, and historical event impacts. Powered by live data, priced per call via x402—not subscriptions.

name: OverWatch
vision: market tools feel dense, number-heavy, and intimidating especially for people who do not enjoy complex metrics or math. OverWatch addresses this by taking real live data from CMC and presenting it in a way that feels alive and human instead of technical.

name: Catalyst Edge
vision: Catalyst Edge turns live CoinMarketCap data into ranked, explainable long and short research setups with transparent entry, target, invalidation, and risk levels.

name: Will RWA Let Me In
vision: My vision is to make RWA investing as simple as asking a question: an agent helps you understand the assets, check what you can access, and prepare transactions you review and sign in your own wallet.

name: Crypto Derivatives Risk Radar
vision: Turn fragmented crypto-derivatives data into a live, transparent view of where market stress is building and what is driving it.

name: TrendLab Market Structure Map
vision: TrendLab helps crypto researchers distinguish broad market participation from moves driven by only large-cap assets or a narrow category, so they can use more precise language before publishing a market narrative.

name: Elephant Tracks
vision: Every DEX flow tool reduces the tape to one signed number, and that number cannot tell one desk selling into a crowd from a thousand matched pairs. Elephant Tracks makes the shape of flow readable from data anyone can already fetch.

name: CMC-Alpha-Terminal
vision: An institutional-grade, zero-heap quantitative screening engine and FastMCP agent gateway powered by the CoinMarketCap Pro API with Power of 10 Deterministic Safety Invariants.
